title: SCHC compression codec: MO/CDA operators, bit-packing
description:
src/compress.rs:
- Mo enum: Equal, Ignore, Msb, MatchMapping
- Cda enum: NotSent, ValueSent, Lsb, Compute, MappingSent
- FieldDescriptor struct with field_id, length_bits, mo, cda, target_value, mo_arg, mapping
- Rule struct: rule_id + slice of FieldDescriptor
- compress(rule, fields, out) -> Result<usize>
- decompress(rule, data, out) -> Result<(usize, Tail)>
- BitWriter/BitReader helpers for sub-byte packing
- No predefined rules - users supply their own
